overview: An AI-powered CRM for sales teams to capture, track, and convert leads. Features role-based access, Kanban pipeline, AI lead scoring, follow-up management, and dashboards — all in a clean, professional interface.
features: Role-based access control (Admin, Sales Manager, Counselor, Telecaller)
Lead management with full schema: name, phone, email, course interest, source, campaign, status, notes, tags
Kanban board with drag-and-drop stage changes and timestamp tracking
Table view with smart filters and search
AI assistant: lead scoring, next action recommendations, message generation, note summarization
Follow-up task management with overdue alerts and recurring tasks
Dashboard with KPI cards, source charts, conversion funnel, and team productivity
Document management for proposals and certificates
Chronological activity timeline on each lead
